propositions: Add a new projects_store.py module to record store-level project-to-repos mapping in .bridge_state/projects.json, separate from binding_store to avoid rewriting large bindings on mapping edits

Implement resolve_project(ticket, mapping) as a pure tri-state function: returns legacy_default for absent keys, None for explicit empty strings or when legacy_default is empty, or the project key for set values
Surface bridge projects operations (list, set, remove) as CLI subcommands under the bridge verb group with MCP parity, where list is a read tool and set/remove are write tools
Require --repos argument on set command (non-zero exit if omitted) and support --repos "" to explicitly store an empty repos list
An absent projects.json record reads as legal with empty mapping and None legacy_default (fail-safe until seeded by ensure units); a malformed record raises an error
Ensure the pinned help file bridge.txt and parser metavar both list projects, and verify mapping writes do not mutate bindings.json or prev_snapshot.json
